caption: The drawing features an abstract botanical form centered on a square, textured brown background with a wide, beige border. The primary object resembles a stylized flower or plant, composed of looping, curving lines forming a symmetrical shape. The upper part of the form has two rounded, dark blue lobes or petals extending outward, each marked with streaks of lighter blue and touches of black at the edges. Between these two lobes are slender, curved lines radiating upwards, suggesting additional stylized petals or tendrils, rendered in brown tones. The center of the form contains a cluster of fine, radiating lines. The lower section of the form splits into two large, leaf-like shapes with dark blue coloring and additional linear accents, along with two smaller, similar shapes branching outward. The colors in the drawing are predominantly muted browns and dark blue, with some lighter highlights, and the entire composition sits against a brown, mottled, roughly rectangular central ground within the overall beige paper.
title: Jug (for Wine, Cider, or Vinegar)
